name: Earth API
description: Independent, maintainer-operated AI API relay for developers using OpenAI-style request formats.
usage_checks: Confirm current account access and API-key creation.
Query the authenticated model catalog before choosing a model.
Review the current account price before generation.
Start with a minimal request and disable automatic retries.
Keep API keys, account tokens, billing details, private prompts, personal data, and production secrets out of public issues and client-side code.
limitations: This file is a repository-hosted integration preview, not a general-availability announcement.
It does not guarantee current model access, pricing, uptime, complete OpenAI API equivalence, or data-retention behavior.
Earth API is independent and does not claim an official relationship with an upstream model provider.
operator_disclosure: Published by the Earth API operator.
content_disclosure: Prepared with AI assistance and reviewed against the observed public launch state.
